feature: Disable failing proactive meme channel through native N.E.K.O setting

before.observed_behavior: Each proactive cycle probed up to three meme candidates; proxy rejected image/jpg candidates and repeated fetch setup coincided with main_server loop stalls around 1.0-1.35 seconds.

reuse_decision: Use the existing N.E.K.O proactiveMemeEnabled authority rather than patching meme_fetcher or building a replacement fetcher.
